title: The Group Chat of Route 9
author: Ines Montrose
blurb: August Almeida, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before graduation.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
